name: skill-map-monorepo
description: skill-map monorepo — houses the public spec and the reference implementation.

scripts.validate: npm run validate:compile && npm run validate:test
scripts.validate:compile: npm run validate:compile -w spec && npm run validate:compile -w src && npm run validate:compile -w testkit && npm run validate:compile -w ui && npm run validate:compile -w web
scripts.validate:test: npm run validate:test -w src && npm run validate:test -w testkit && npm run validate:test -w ui && npm run validate:test -w e2e && npm run validate:test -w examples/hello-world
scripts.release:version: node scripts/build-user-changelog.js && changeset version && npm run pin --workspace=@skill-map/spec && npm run spec --workspace=@skill-map/spec && npm run reference --workspace=@skill-map/cli
